examples.text: Подожди, нам твои деньги не нужны.
examples.trans: Wait, we do not need your money.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'until', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Надо придумать, где установить большой подиум.
examples.trans: We need to figure out where to set up the big runway.

examples.text: Отлично, я приеду за день до показа.
examples.trans: Excellent, I will arrive a day before the show.

examples.text: Будь добр, принеси мне горячий кофе.
examples.trans: Be so kind, bring me a hot coffee.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'you (informal)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Костя, ты почему так на неё смотрел?
examples.trans: Kostya, why were you staring at her like that?

examples.text: Слушай, ты знаешь такую известную певицу?
examples.trans: Listen, do you know such a famous singer?

examples.text: Ты поезжай домой, а я останусь здесь.
examples.trans: You go on home, and I will stay here.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'чему').

examples.text: Костя, ты почему так на неё смотрел?
examples.trans: Kostya, why were you staring at her like that?

examples.text: Почему ты к телефону не подходишь?
examples.trans: Why are you not answering your phone?

examples.text: Почему он попросил меня там пить?
examples.trans: Why did he ask me to drink up there?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'so', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Костя, ты почему так на неё смотрел?
examples.trans: Kostya, why were you staring at her like that?

examples.text: В таком платье ходят не на работу.
examples.trans: One does not go to work in a dress like that.

examples.text: Слушай, ты знаешь такую известную певицу?
examples.trans: Listen, do you know such a famous singer?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'on, onto', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Да, я внимательно слушаю, Элеонора Андреевна.
examples.trans: Yes, I am listening attentively, Eleonora Andreyevna.

examples.text: Миша, скоро у нас модный показ.
examples.trans: Misha, soon we will have a fashion show.

examples.text: Нам нужно очень хорошо к нему подготовиться.
examples.trans: We need to prepare very well for it.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'she; it', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она мечтала петь именно в вашем платье.
examples.trans: She dreamed of singing in your dress specifically.

examples.text: Она у нас очень известная певица.
examples.trans: She is a very famous singer in our country.

examples.text: Она сегодня действительно прекрасно выглядит.
examples.trans: She really looks wonderful today.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мотреть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'watched', paired with 'посмотреть'.

examples.text: Костя, ты почему так на неё смотрел?
examples.trans: Kostya, why were you staring at her like that?

examples.text: Нет, милая, я никуда не смотрел.
examples.trans: No, darling, I was not looking anywhere.

examples.text: Как ты можешь смотреть мне в глаза?
examples.trans: How can you look me in the eyes?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'no', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Нет, милая, я никуда не смотрел.
examples.trans: No, darling, I was not looking anywhere.

examples.text: А то в зале свободных официантов нет.
examples.trans: Because there are no free waiters in the hall.

examples.text: Нет проблем, Костя, я тебе помогу.
examples.trans: No problem, Kostya, I will help you.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('sweet, dear').

examples.text: Нет, милая, я никуда не смотрел.

examples.text: У вас русских очень сложные фамилии.
examples.trans: You Russians have very complicated last names.

examples.text: Мы честно кормили тебя два дня.
examples.trans: We honestly fed you for two days.

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)
